title: Scalar-flat Kähler surfaces whose Weyl tensor annihilates the Ricci form
summary: We conjecture that any scalar-flat Kähler surface in which the Weyl tensor acting on 2-forms annihilates the Ricci form must be either Ricci-flat or locally isometric to a Riemannian product of two real surfaces with mutually opposite nonzero constant Gaussian curvatures. This amounts to the nonexistence of proper weakly Einstein anti-self-dual Kähler surfaces. We prove the above conjecture in three special cases: when the manifold is compact, when one of the Ricci eigendistributions is integrable, and when the norms of the Ricci and Weyl tensors are functionally dependent
